product_wide_rationale: Governs the one session route into an implementation worktree, so its capture and resume shapes bind every Domain rather than one runtime Domain.
summary: concord_work_start accepts a resume shape naming an existing item by work identity. The work-resume path reuses an active entry read-only or durably bootstraps a missing canonical worktree under the original work identity after the same Product, Project, terminal, and origin guards. The adapter runs the same session-prepare, move, and read-back tail as a capture.
title: work start resumes an existing item by work identity
